Define publication gates, release manifests and acceptance records for the first eligible subset.

## Deliverables

- Publication gate checklist
- Release acceptance record format

- `docs/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md`
- `planning/release-manifest.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each release cites its manifest and review records

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A release requires rights, editorial and evidence acceptance per record
- [ ] Withheld records cannot be released
- [ ] Release manifest validates

## Non-goals

- Releasing before gates pass
